claims.statement: The frontend is layered into src/domain (contracts only), src/application (pure reducers), src/ui (controllers, view, template, widgets), and src/adapters (TauriBackend); scripts/check-architecture.ts enforces that domain imports nothing from the other layers, application and ui never import ../adapters/ or @tauri-apps/*, and adapters never import ../ui/ or ../application/.

BackendPort is the port contract between the UI controllers and the native runtime, owned by the inner layers in src/domain/backend.ts and implemented only by TauriBackend in src/adapters/tauri-backend.ts; it covers environment, credentials, settings, transcription/refinement/import, artifacts, recording, file dialogs, and the two event listeners, and its listeners return plain () => void unlisten functions rather than Tauri types.

src/adapters/tauri-backend.ts is the only frontend module permitted to import @tauri-apps/* or zod, and every native response (environment, setup, transcription, assistant settings, refinement, import, recording status/result/failure) is parsed with a Zod schema before entering frontend state; job and recording events are likewise parsed inside the listen callbacks.

toJobEvent translates raw job-event payloads: a prepared event's snake_case engine_version is renamed onto the domain field engineVersion, and a payload the Zod schema rejects becomes a visible log line (stream "frontend", message containing the JSON dump) attributed to the payload's jobId when one can be salvaged — because a throw inside Tauri's callback would be swallowed and the event would silently disappear.

Native commands fail with AppError {code, message} whose message is Korean user copy; errorMessage() returns that message only for objects carrying both string code and message (lookalikes rejected) and substitutes the stable copy "예기치 못한 오류가 발생했습니다." for runtime faults, while errorDetail() preserves the raw diagnostic, which AppController.handleFailure appends to the job log as "[frontend] <detail>" when it differs from the user copy.

AppController.start() binds all controls synchronously before its first await, then subscribes listenToJobs and listenToRecordingFailures before any operation that emits events; if either subscription rejects it shows the visible banner "네이티브 런타임에 연결할 수 없습니다. 앱을 다시 실행해 주세요." and returns instead of piling up IPC errors, while the already-bound controls keep the shell usable.

Every frontend operation (prepare, transcribe, refine, importTranscript) mints its jobId with crypto.randomUUID() in the window before invoking, so the first worker event already belongs to that job, and reduceJobEvent complements this by returning the identical state object for events whose jobId differs from the tracked one.

The job-machine reducer is pure and immutable with these invariants: settled statuses ignore late phase events, percent never moves backwards within the same phase, log messages split on newlines and are prefixed "[<stream>]" with the list capped at the last 200 lines, and failure is announced exactly once — the polite slot holds the stable line "작업이 실패했습니다." while the specific cause goes to the alert slot.

Cancellation is modeled as a user decision rather than a failure: cancelJob sets status "cancelled" with error null, and failJob leaves an already-cancelled state unchanged so the process-death error raised by the kill is not reported as a new failure.

The recording machine gates starts to idle/completed/failed (so a second click during permission-pending "starting" does nothing), computes elapsed time from startedAtMs wall-clock deltas rather than counting interval ticks so backgrounded-timer suspension cannot lose time, and settles the finished elapsed time on the recorder-reported durationSeconds with warning=true when droppedFrames > 0.

RecordingController buffers recording-event failures that arrive while startRecording is still pending, keyed by recordingId; when start resolves a buffered failure triggers cleanupFailure, which cancels the partial recording and settles failed with the native message, appending an additional "...부분 녹음 파일 정리에도 실패했습니다: ..." note if the cleanup cancel itself fails.

During an active recording, RecordingController re-ticks on a 1-second interval plus visibilitychange and focus listeners (the first moment a suspended counter can catch up), and a tick that changes only the clock takes the narrow path of updating setRecordingTime alone, leaving buttons, path, and status line untouched.

A completed recording hands its finished WAV path to the callback AppController wires at construction, which sets audioPath and calls view.setAudio, so a stopped recording becomes the transcription input without a file picker.

Settings autosave is a single-flight loop: committed edits set settingsSavePending and, when no write is active, flushSettingsSaves drains pending flags so edits made during an in-progress write coalesce into one latest-state write; within a write the Hugging Face token is saved only when a new value was typed (pendingToken() returns null while a token is stored, so roster edits never trigger a macOS keychain prompt), and on failure the sheet preserves edited values and retries on the next change.

Switching the engine preset saves immediately via saveEnginePreset and re-diagnoses so the setup panel reflects the switch, with no Apply step; the picker lives in the always-reachable settings dialog because the setup panel hides itself once the selected engine is ready, which would otherwise swallow the control.

Importing an existing txt/md transcript is a first-class result: it is stored as lastResult, rendered via renderImportedTranscript with the subtitle and checkpoint rows hidden, and it unlocks the augment button so minutes can be produced without a new recording or transcription; the file picker opens at the current output root as its default path.

AppView fails fast on template drift: element() caches required selector lookups per instance and throws a Korean error when a selector is missing, and the sub-views share the required() helper in src/ui/dom.ts, so a missing element is a loud defect rather than a threaded null.

One JobViewState renders into whichever progress card matches the active BusyKind — #setup-progress-panel, #job-panel, or #augment-progress — each stage rendering its own progress card in place, and the cancel button is shown only for the active kind.

Transient action errors surface in the persistent #app-error banner (role="alert") because the in-panel error slots live inside progress cards that are hidden while idle and therefore cannot carry idle-time failures.

The stage rail mirrors three user stages (transcribe, results, augment) driven by data-state with aria-current="step" on the current item; engine/model preparation is a pre-gate panel (00 / 준비), not a stage, and it hides once the environment is ready except within the session where the user ran preparation so the completion message stays visible.

src/main.ts is the entire frontend composition root: it constructs TauriBackend and AppView over #app, hands them to AppController, awaits start(), and registers a once beforeunload handler that calls controller.stop(), which unsubscribes both event listeners and disposes the RecordingController (cancelling any active recording).

The UI markup/style contract is three-way — src/ui/app-template.ts, src/styles.css, and DESIGN.md must stay aligned (palette, typography, Korean keep-all word breaking, status always text+color, no invented ETAs) — and src/styles.test.ts guards part of it by asserting the global html [hidden] display:none rule and the four-track .workspace grid rows (the VQA-006 banner-collapse regression), while token-settings.test.ts asserts the credential input is type="text" with autocomplete="off" to avoid WebView password restoration.

The frontend slice of the cross-runtime job-event contract is one change set — rawJobEventSchema in the adapter, the JobEvent union in src/domain/job.ts, and the exhaustive switch in reduceJobEvent — so a new event variant is a compile error in the reducer until every layer handles it, the intended extension path over a default branch.

TokenSettingsView implements the settings dialog as an APG modal: it remembers the invoking element, moves focus to the close button on open, sets the inert property on background siblings while open (aria-modal alone does not stop Tab), closes on Escape, and restores focus to the invoker on close.

Domain normalization rules keep stored settings clean: usableParticipants trims and drops nameless participant rows (a participant without a name cannot label a speaker), aliases parse from one comma-separated field, optional free text collapses to null via emptyToNull so empty strings never read as values, and retainSelection prunes attendee selection to the current roster in roster order.

Selecting attendees auto-fills the speaker hint (mode exact with the selection count plus a note saying it was auto-filled) while a later manual change is left alone; before a transcription job starts, buildSpeakerHint validates the form in the domain (positive integers, min ≤ max) so invalid input fails with Korean copy instead of an IPC round trip.

Native dialogs and external links live in the adapter: chooseAudio filters m4a/mp3/wav/mp4/mov/aac/flac/ogg, chooseTranscript filters txt/md and honors the Galpi meeting root defaultPath, chooseOutputDirectory opens a directory picker, and openModelAccessPage opens the pyannote model-access page via plugin-opener; each returns null when the user cancels.

Frontend tests are colocated Bun tests: pure reducer and adapter tests have no DOM, while the DOM suites construct a happy-dom Window, inject the real styles.css into a style element, and drive the real AppView/AppController; controller tests substitute complete BackendPort fakes (including one whose every method rejects), which is possible precisely because ui/ depends only on the domain port.
